propositions: The mapping seam adds new config surface and behaviors (breadcrumb, replay, probe) that require authoritative end-to-end documentation and operator guidance.
Plan-review portability criterion requires that no mapping capability is gated by a specific CI provider; the seam must function across diverse or absent CI environments.
The feature is additive and backward-compatible: an absent [tool.rebar.mapping] section reproduces today's hardcoded behavior, with rollback via section deletion.
Every mapping behavior is exercised by in-process unit tests with injected transports requiring no live Jira and no specific CI provider; the probe degrades gracefully offline and is never a CI gate.
Documentation must establish the provider-neutral core as the reuse seam for future targets (Linear/GitLab/GitHub-Issues) outside current scope.
The three-layer config merge, per-project keying, fail-closed validation, and orthogonality to .bridge_state/projects.json must be documented in config reference.
